hook: Jensen Huang quit Nvidia. Now he's back.
reel_hook: He quit Nvidia. Then came back.

slides.title: Huang returns to Nvidia
slides.image_prompt: A black leather jacket draped back over an empty executive chair beside a glowing green computer chip, dramatic spotlight in a dark office
slides.label: TECHNOLOGY
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Nvidia's board unanimously reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO.
WHY IT MATTERS
Board consulted US officials, found no national security risk.
FOR YOU
If you hold tech or index funds, Nvidia's 31% jump likely lifted them.
slides.body: Nvidia's board unanimously reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO. Board consulted US officials, found no national security risk. If you hold tech or index funds, Nvidia's 31% jump likely lifted them.

slides.title: At least 15 killed near Kyiv
slides.image_prompt: A partly collapsed apartment block at dusk, rubble in the foreground and a single flashlight beam cutting through dust, muted colors
slides.label: WORLD
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Russian strikes on the Kyiv region killed at least 15.
WHY IT MATTERS
Homes, a supermarket and energy facilities were hit.
FOR YOU
Officials say 11 died in Dymer alone; the toll may still change.
slides.body: Russian strikes on the Kyiv region killed at least 15. Homes, a supermarket and energy facilities were hit. Officials say 11 died in Dymer alone; the toll may still change.

slides.title: COP31 ends without a deal
slides.image_prompt: An unsigned blank document on a long empty conference table, a melting globe-shaped ice sculpture beside it, factory smokestacks visible through the window
slides.label: WORLD
points: WHAT HAPPENED
UN climate talks in Antalya collapsed Sunday without a deal.
WHY IT MATTERS
Countries couldn't agree on moving away from fossil fuels.
FOR YOU
No new global fossil fuel deal for now; what comes next is unclear.
slides.body: UN climate talks in Antalya collapsed Sunday without a deal. Countries couldn't agree on moving away from fossil fuels. No new global fossil fuel deal for now; what comes next is unclear.

slides.title: Candy factory fire in Indonesia
slides.image_prompt: Thick black smoke rising from an industrial building at night, scattered colorful wrapped candies on wet pavement in the foreground
slides.label: WORLD
points: WHAT HAPPENED
A fire tore through a candy factory in Banten, Indonesia.
WHY IT MATTERS
Dozens are feared dead and the search continues.
FOR YOU
Officials first reported 3 dead and 36 missing; the toll may rise.
slides.body: A fire tore through a candy factory in Banten, Indonesia. Dozens are feared dead and the search continues. Officials first reported 3 dead and 36 missing; the toll may rise.

slides.title: $900 billion in one day
slides.image_prompt: A towering stack of gold coins beside a giant green upward arrow built from glowing computer chips, against a dark background
slides.label: CURIOSITY
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Nvidia shares closed up about 31% on Monday.
WHY IT MATTERS
CNN called it the stock's third-best day on record.
FOR YOU
Reuters says the jump adds over US$900 billion in market value.
slides.body: Nvidia shares closed up about 31% on Monday. CNN called it the stock's third-best day on record. Reuters says the jump adds over US$900 billion in market value.
